stories.title: Connah’s Quay power station project moves to decision stage as examination ends
stories.summary: The six-month examination of Uniper’s plans for a new carbon capture power station at Connah’s Quay has closed, moving the project into its decision stage. stories.title: Person banned from Deeside pubs for 10 years after Pubwatch meeting
stories.summary: A person has been banned from pubs in the Deeside area for 10 years following a meeting of the local Pubwatch scheme. stories.title: One in four adults in Wales now has poor mental health, and poverty is driving it, charity says
stories.summary: More than one in four adults in Wales are experiencing poor mental health, around 720,000 people, according to a new report from the Mental Health Foundation.
